# How rain is made

## The water cycle

Water never stops moving. The sun lifts water from the sea as vapour. The vapour cools into cloud as it rises. Rain and snow fall on the land. Rivers carry the water back to the sea, and the cycle repeats.

## Inside the Earth

The Earth is built in layers. The inner core is a solid ball of iron at the centre. Around it lies the liquid outer core. The mantle, a thick layer of slowly flowing rock, surrounds the core. The crust is the thin outer layer we live on.

## Why it matters

Fresh water is scarce. Only a small share of the planet's water is fresh, and most of that is locked in ice.
